claim: Patchline ships a machine-checked appendix re-verified on every commit with a public proof-status badge. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the machine-checked appendix claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make machine-checked-appendix-2-gate`.
